evidence_quotes.agenda: This is a post-booking 'kickoff call' re-confirming logistics for an already-booked move, not a fresh discovery call — no quid pro quo framing or agenda question either way.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: 'I'm still going to need to find out from the complex... I don't know if the truck can access the parking garage' — a genuine Stage-1-timed concern; rep explained the truck's size limitation but never followed up on a resolution (e.g. the utility elevator she mentioned), scored shallow.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'this is just an estimate... we only factored in a little extra time... a realistic worst case number now than be surprised by a higher total later' — the only Save Your Ass element present; no rate-lock line, no explicit 'beats it, pay less,' no self-prep tip, no fairness check.

top_strength: Proactively flagged the 26-foot truck's size limitation when the customer raised the new building's parking-garage uncertainty, instead of glossing over it.
coaching_note: As a kickoff/re-confirmation call it never re-delivered the differentiator block (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time/Communication) — worth a quick recap even on a repeat touch, and the parking-garage worry was left unresolved rather than followed up on.
